messages:
jordan: heads-up: onboarding sample app hitting a weird failure in the rerank flow when using the embed-batcher helper + short-lived token. getting vector_dim_mismatch on retry.

priya: which SDK and helper config? paste the minimal payload.

jordan: Node `@redwood/inference` v0.8.4, sampleapp uses embed-batcher with batching.pad_to_multiple=6. payload (sanitized):

```json
{"items":[{"id":"a","text":"one"},{"id":"b","text":"two"}],"batching":{"max_batch_size":12,"pad_to_multiple":6}}
```

jordan: Sequence: first POST -> 200, embeddings 768-dim. token refresh happens, SDK retries by reassembling a padded batch; second POST -> 400 with error body saying expected 768 got 1536.

marta: interesting — python sampleapp?

jordan: python `redwood-sdk` v1.4.0 behaves fine. node helper appears to keep a global fallback DIM=1536 and the retry path uses that when server error envelope lacks model info.

lin: can you paste raw server error body from the 400?

jordan: error: {"error":{"code":"vector_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 768 got 1536","meta":{"expected":768,"got":1536}},"request_id":"r_202"}  

priya: that matches a bug we've seen: Node normalizer caches model dim on a shared module and the retry builder falls back to a DEFAULT_EMBED_DIM when `model` is missing in an error response. two fixes: make model dim per-call and stash original request shapes in call metadata so retry reuses them.

marta: also double-check the envelope parity: server sometimes returns `vectors` envelope for batch rerank and sometimes `data`+`embedding` for the embeddings endpoint. if the normalizer rewrites envelopes before dim inference that could cause the pad helper to pick the wrong size.

jordan: logs from repro run:  
[15:03:12] POST /v1/embeddings 200 len=11008 auth=ok model=open-embed-768-v1
[15:03:13] POST /v1/embeddings 400 len=5120 auth=refresh 
-- error body above --

lin: thanks. short-term workaround for customers: set pad_to_multiple:1 or pin node SDK to v0.7.x. long-term we need tests.

priya: action items: (1) open GH issue with logs + curl repro (assign to @marta), (2) change embed-batcher helper to never mutate module-level model dim, and ensure retry reuses per-call shapes, (3) add unit test simulating error envelope without `model` plus token refresh, and (4) integration test that flips server envelopes between `vectors` and `data` to catch normalizer regressions.

marta: I'll open the issue and add a failing unit test. quick fix in the helper: if model field missing on error, read the dim from the original request body (if present) before falling back to DEFAULT.

jordan: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/512 "embed-batcher: retry uses fallback dim when error envelope lacks model, causing vector_dim_mismatch". attached logs and minimal repro.

infra-bot: Issue created: sampleapp#512 by jordan - "embed-batcher: retry uses fallback dim when error envelope lacks model, causing vector_dim_mismatch"

priya: thanks. also update docs to call out pad_to_multiple tradeoffs and recommend small multiples for early onboarding.

marta: PR incoming, will link in the issue. leaving this thread. :thumbsup:
